craft_notes: Sthāyin: crown — guru-body seventh, text-end. Rows: exaltation then fulfillment; Śivam lands last. Rejected: inventing colophon — killed: GRETIL ends here, recorded. Read aloud: closing bell.

lines: In the master's frame burns the seventh clan-rite, crown of all —
done once of old beside the rites, it fills the whole. Śivam.
l4.sanskrit_cite: guruśarīre saptamaḥ kulayāgaḥ sarvottamaḥ so 'pi prāg yāgasāhityena sakṛd eva kṛtaḥ sarvaṃ pūrayati iti śivam
